messages:
ellie: Heads-up — starting partner coordination for Okinawa region with MaruSystems. Need cloud quotas, KMS entitlements, marketplace listing, and SI integration tests. Any immediate blockers?
marco-partners: MaruSystems says initial ask = 10 GPUs (A100) for 2-week ramp. Also wants dedicated VPC option.
adrian-eng: I'll check infra capacity. Short answer: limited for A100 in that region; need quota form. @deploy-bot can you open a ticket?
deploy-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-3129 — 'Okinawa GPU quota request (MaruSystems)'. ETA: 48h.
sanjay-ops: Also flagging network peering + ASN details. If partner wants private VPC, we'll need to schedule peering window.
karin-legal: For marketplace listing we require signed DPA, partner PO, and security attestation. I'll send the DPA template and security questionnaire to Marco.
ellie: Proposed timeline: Week0 = quota + KMS request; Week1 = SI tests + canary; Week2 = marketplace cert + soft announcement. Thoughts?
adrian-eng: Works for infra. KMS: confirm Cloud KMS availability in Okinawa and decide key import vs. customer-managed key. HSM increases lead-time.
marco-partners: Maru flagged HSM preference but can accept Cloud KMS if we provide an attestation and key access audit.
karin-legal: Attestation ok, but we need completed security questionnaire (SQ-101). Marco — can you gather?
marco-partners: Yep — I'll collect and upload answers by EOD.
ellie: Small checklist for visibility:
```
- [ ] Submit cloud quota request (INFRA-3129)
- [ ] Create KMS key + IAM grant to Maru service account
- [ ] Draft marketplace listing + pricing SKU
- [ ] SI test plan (latency, peering, burst capacity)
- [ ] Legal: DPA + security questionnaire
- [ ] Product: create canary route and fallback policy
- [ ] Marketing: press sync & joint blog draft
```
sanjay-ops: SI test plan notes: want 3 endpoints — canary, scale test for throughput, long-tail for cold-starts. Draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/okinawa-test-plan
ellie: Marketing check — @karen-sales can you confirm press window? aiming for mid-April if we hit timeline.
karen-sales: Mid-April is ambitious. If marketplace certs are in by Apr 6 we can do a soft announce Apr 14 and a broader partner blog Apr 21. I'll prep a draft.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: 'Okinawa Launch sync' — Thu 09:00 PT. Invites sent to participants.
adrian-eng: INFRA update: quota request submitted to cloud provider. They quoted ~3 business days to confirm A100 availability.
ellie: Any blockers for SI integration (BGP, ASN, certs)?
marco-partners: SI team needs BGP+ASN, test IPs, and mTLS cert exchange. I'll share ASN and CSR by EOD.
karin-legal: Quick reminder: export control check for Okinawa nodes — looks clear but we'll need an export classification note added to the partner file.
ellie: Great. I'll update the partner playbook and post the finalized checklist here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
